notes: End every working set 1–2 reps short of failure (unless the note says 'to failure').
Double progression: hit the top of the rep range on every set, then add weight next time.
Only managed 3 days this week? Carry the 4th day into next week, so nothing gets skipped.
Deload the week of 16 Nov: about 40% lighter, same exercises, to peak fresh for the wedding on 26 Nov.
Travel: Spain (IDIADA) 26–31 Oct. Morning sessions, 45 minutes: main lifts and shoulders first.

sessions.name: Day 1 · Upper Strength
sessions.focus: Heavy press and pull, shoulder width, neck and posture
warmup: Chin tucks lying on your back, 2×10 with a 5s hold each
2 warm-up bench sets: empty bar ×10, then about 60% ×5

exercises.name: Bench press
exercises.target: 65 kg: stay until 6 reps on all 4 sets, then 67.5 kg
exercises.notes: Shoulder blades pinched, feet planted. Stop 1–2 reps short of failure.

exercises.name: Weighted pull-ups
exercises.target: Bodyweight × 6 on all 3 sets, then add weight (dip belt or a dumbbell between the feet)
exercises.notes: Full hang at the bottom, chest to the bar.

exercises.name: Seated DB shoulder press
exercises.notes: Back supported, don't flare the ribs.

exercises.name: Barbell row
exercises.notes: Torso about 45°, pull to the lower ribs.

exercises.name: Cable lateral raise
exercises.notes: Last set to failure. Lead with the elbow, don't swing. This builds the capped shoulders.

exercises.name: Face pulls
exercises.notes: Rope to the eyes, 1s hold at the back. Good for posture.

exercises.name: Curls + triceps pushdowns (superset)
exercises.notes: Go straight from one to the other, then rest.

sessions.name: Day 2 · Lower Strength
warmup: Bodyweight squats ×10, leg swings ×10 each side

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.notes: Brace hard, hit depth, stop 1–2 reps short of failure.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.notes: Hips back, bar close to the legs, feel the hamstring stretch.

exercises.name: Walking lunges
exercises.notes: Dumbbells at your sides.

exercises.name: Calf raises
exercises.notes: 2s pause at the bottom.

exercises.name: Hanging leg raises
exercises.notes: No swinging, curl the pelvis up.

sessions.name: Day 3 · Upper Size
warmup: Neck isometrics: hand against the forehead, the back of the head and each side, 50% effort, 2×10s each

exercises.name: Wide-grip pull-ups or lat pulldown
exercises.notes: Think elbows to the hips, which builds width.

exercises.name: Single-arm cable pulldown
exercises.notes: Each arm.

exercises.name: Cable Y-raise
exercises.notes: Light, smooth, thumbs up.

exercises.name: Lateral raises
exercises.notes: Dumbbells, slight lean forward.

exercises.name: Rear-delt flyes
exercises.notes: Pec-deck reverse or bent-over dumbbells.

exercises.name: Prone Y-raises
exercises.notes: Face down on an incline bench, chin tucked. For posture.

exercises.name: Curls + triceps
exercises.notes: Superset.

sessions.name: Day 4 · Lower Size
sessions.focus: Hinge strength, leg volume and lats

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.notes: Reset each rep, neutral neck (don't look up).

exercises.name: Straight-arm pulldown
exercises.notes: Lats, for V-taper.
